set.body: PRD X-9 through X-11 and DET-1 through DET-4. Directed baseline priorities derive from Seed, SampleId, focal KeyDigest, and candidate KeyDigest only; cap and eligibility stay out, preserving cap monotonicity and stratum stability. KeyDigest derives through Mirror, obeys Eq consistency, never uses hashCode or toString, and agrees on JVM and Scala.js.
